description: Turn a user's need into a ready-to-send enquiry for IBDÅ. Returns a draft message, the link to IBDÅ's project page (https://projects.ibda.co/start, in English), a one-click email link to hello@ibda.co when the draft is short enough, a reference code and what IBDÅ does next. This tool sends nothing and does not store the enquiry: the user reviews the draft and sends it themselves. Only "summary" is required; a finished brief is not needed, so do not press the user for a stage, timeline or budget they do not have. Not for job applications (use https://www.ibda.co/careers).

areas.description: Which areas the need touches, in the user's own words (one or more), for example "IoT or connected system" or "Government or public-sector innovation".

contact_email.description: Optional. Used only in the draft.

contact_name.description: Optional. Used only to sign the draft.

language.description: Optional. With ar, the result also links IBDÅ's Arabic introduction page. The project page is in English.

location.description: Where the organization or project is based.

outcomes.description: Outcomes currently needed, in the user's own words (one or more), for example "Proof of concept".

role.description: The user's role in the organization.

stage.description: Current stage, in the user's own words.

summary.description: The idea, challenge or opportunity in the user's own words: what they hope to create, improve, investigate or make possible.

timeline.description: Target timeline, if the user has one, in their own words.

name: prepare_project_enquiry
title: Prepare a project enquiry for IBDÅ
